CRITICAL - DO NOT USE THESE NUMBERS. A JustDial listing ('Dr Sanjeeva Rao (Gurunanak Care Hospital), Opposite Raja Delux Theatre, Bakaram, Musheerabad') also surfaced; JustDial numbers are call-tracking proxies and were not recorded. No published email, personal mobile, LinkedIn, clinic site or research profile was found in five query variations, so those fields are blank rather than guessed.
